name: Mandala
author: Erin Carter
description: A single centred mandala of nested polar petal rings, drawn as thin luminous strokes over near-black. Every ring's petals slowly remold among teardrop, almond, trefoil, and thorn silhouettes on an unbounded per-ring phase — the ornament is always mid-transformation, never spinning, never repeating.

params.label: Morph speed
params.effect: Rate of the petal metamorphosis; at minimum a petal takes most of a minute to remold from one archetype to the next, at maximum the ornament visibly melts between forms.

params.label: Petals
params.effect: Petal count of the innermost ring (outer rings scale up proportionally); higher reads lacier, lower bolder.

params.label: Ring spacing
params.effect: Radial distance between petal rings in CSS px; smaller packs many fine rings into the frame, larger yields a few bold rings with bigger petals.

params.label: Breath
params.effect: Amplitude of the slow radial breathing of each ring; 0 pins the rings perfectly still (petal morphing alone carries the motion), 1 lets rings visibly swell and relax against their neighbours.
